climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: Pennsylvania's first AVA, in Lancaster and Chester counties around the city of Lancaster. The valley is about 31 miles long and 12 wide and covers 225,000 acres, with about 400 acres under vine. Climate was not a factor in setting its boundary.
